'''Johnny Marbels''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a younger brother, [[Jimmy Marbels|Jimmy]], who was attempting to find him.<ref name="RPG" />
